debugData.name: Desert dunes (cube)
debugData.description: The desert-dunes cube's six 2048 PNGs as one cube texture asset: the asset pipeline encodes them as one ETC1S KTX2 cube at 1024 per face (p311 Phase 2). The faces in the order scene01's desert-dunes lists them (its y faces swapped), so its sky box keeps flipY.
